notes.title: Improvements And Demo Available
notes.content:
[h3]Now Endocrisis have a map with saving progress. You can play the game and complete stages or defeat bosses in any order.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39463890/8392b7a3909c8b6a0ad017b897f7c63aed47af92.png[/img]


[h3]When you stop shooting, the whole spaceship is covered with armor that blocks any impact and decreases your energy bar.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39463890/4f8d6c415e53411c726d4d2de0287fea87a4b8f2.png[/img]


[h3]It is clearer to know the number of enemies to destroy on each stage to power up your ship. Each stage has a different powerup[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39463890/06d9dfeead3571f0952a80acdceb010e27c35c67.png[/img]


[h3]Another mayor updates[/h3]
Absorb graphic is more clear
Bosses and enemies now have less health.
Power shot now deals more damage 
Code improvement
Bug fixes.

notes.title: New Demo update
notes.content:
New beta launched which no longer has auto-shot, changes in the interface and medals when completing each level

Some significant changes

[b] The Power Shot is added [/ b]
Powerful shot that consumes power bar
[img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /39463890/d1d302519f266a11eeb68b4a5118d097f8c4af15.gif [/ img]

[b] Absorb [/ b]
Absorb enemy shots to regain power
[img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /39463890/189d75ebed26dc6dca4bb38ab81b158a24e0dc92.gif [/ img]

[b] Tutorial [/ b]
Learn to operate the ship in a short tutorial
